response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts), above AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.cnt, c.cnt - a.avg_cnt AS diff_from_avg FROM counts c, avg_all a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt), avg_above AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_above_cnt FROM above) SELECT ab.account_id, ab.cnt AS order_count, ab.diff_from_avg, ab.cnt - aa.avg_above_cnt AS diff_from_above_avg FROM above ab, avg_above aa ORDER BY diff_from_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
